computation-library-root.name: Mortality_DynLapse
computation-library-root.description: Mortality - UDD assumption Lapse - always at month end with Dynamic Lapse

UserUDFs.udf:
/*
 Lapse\sinterest\sfactor\sfunction\swith\srespect\sto
 policy\selapsed\stime,\sincome\sbase,\sshort\srate,\saccount\svalue\sand\smaximum\sannual\swithdrawal\samount.
 
 Input\sof\sfunction:
 
 J_idt:\spolicy\selpased\stime
 \(Int\beta_1\):\sparameter\scalculated\sin\sMortality_DynLapse.projection
 \(Int\beta_2\):\sparameter\scalculated\sin\sMortality_DynLapse.projection
 GMWB_mbb:\sincome\sbase
 r:\sshort\srate
 AV:\stotal\saccount\svalue\send\sof\sprojection\speriod
 mawa:\smaximum\sannual\swithdrawal\samount
 other\sparameters:\s\(\beta_0\),\s\(\beta_3\),\s\(\beta_4\)
 
 Intermediate\svariables:
 
 \(\beta_3\text{_new}\),\s\(G\),\s\(P_0\),\s\(P\)
 
 Formulas:
 
 $$\beta_3\text{_}new\s=\s\max(\beta_3\times\frac{GMWB\text{_}mbb}{AV},\frac{mawa}{AV})$$
 
 $$\sG\s=\s\beta_0+\beta_1\times\max(0,r-\beta_3\text{_}new)\s$$
 
 $$\sP_0\s=\s(\beta_2-1)\times\frac{\exp(\beta_0)}{1+\exp(\beta_0)}+1\s$$
 
 $$\sP\s=\s\begin{cases}
 \frac{1}{P_0}\times((\beta_2-1)\times\frac{\exp(G)}{1+\exp(G)}+1),\s&\sG<10\s\\
 \frac{1}{P_0}\times\beta_2,\s&\sG\geq\s10
 \end{cases}\s$$
 
 $$\sLapseIntFac\s=\s1+(P-1)\times\max(\frac{\beta_4-J\text{_}idt}{\beta_4},0)\s$$
 
 */
 real\sLapseIntFacCalculator(real\sJ_idt,\sreal\saLapseIntBeta1,\sreal\saLapseIntBeta2,\sreal\sGMWB_mbb,\sreal\sr,\sreal\sAV,\sreal\smawa)
 \s\s\s\sreal\sbeta0\s=\s-5.0
 \s\s\s\sreal\sbeta3\s=\s0.05
 \s\s\s\sreal\sbeta4\s=\s40.0
 \s\s\s\s
 \s\s\s\sreal\sbeta3_new\s=\smax(beta3\s*\sGMWB_mbb,\smawa)/AV
 \s\s\s\sreal\sG\s=\sbeta0\s+\saLapseIntBeta1\s*\smax(0.0,\sr\s-\sbeta3_new)
 \s\s\s\sreal\sP0\s=\s(aLapseIntBeta2\s-\s1.0)\s*\sexp(beta0)/(1.0\s+\sexp(beta0))\s+\s1.0
 \s\s\s\s
 \s\s\s\sreal\sP\s=\s0.0
 \s\s\s\s
 \s\s\s\sif\s(G<10)\sthen
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sP\s=\s1.0\s/\sP0\s*\s((aLapseIntBeta2\s-1)\s*\sexp(G)\s/\s(1+exp(G))\s+\s1)
 \s\s\s\selse
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sP\s=\s1.0\s/\sP0\s*\saLapseIntBeta2
 \s\s\s\send
 \s\s\s\s
 \s\s\s\s$result\s=\s1.0\s+\s(P\s-\s1)\s*\smax((beta4\s-\sJ_idt)/beta4,\s0)
 \s\s\s\s
 end
